## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Refer the below table for the sessions supported and its sub function reference numbers with access levels.

- Refer [UDS Services](supported-uds-services.html){.topiclink} for the supported UDS Services for the Customer Instance.

 

  ---------------------------------- --------------------- --------------------------
  Diagnostic Sessions                Sub Function Number   Security Access Level
  EXTENDED_DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION        0x03                  All Customer Levels 1-10
  SAFETY_SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTIC_SESSION   0x04                  All Customer Levels 1-10
  EOL_SESSION                        0x40                  All Customer Levels 1-10
  ---------------------------------- --------------------- --------------------------
